credits.title: Being Heumann
credits.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

credits.title: Best Summer Ever
credits.overview: A high school football player is shocked to discover that the new girl in school is the same girl he fell in love with at a summer dance camp.
